title: •Grrrghrrrgh!
caption: •Let The Wookiee Win (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. If your Wookiee just lost, may stack it here. Wookiees are deploy -1, immune to attrition < X and defense value +X, where X = number of cards here. During any battle, may place a card here out of play to add one destiny to total power. {alter}
lore: “It’s not wise to upset a Wookiee.” “But sir, nobody worries about upsetting a droid.” “That’s ‘cause a droid don’t pull people’s arms out of their sockets when they lose.”
